name: Shipping registers — 20th-century maritime newspapers
description: Multi-column English newspapers with ship registers and dense tables. Two genres: index pages are one wide table without rules; voyage supplements are parallel columns of ship entries.

index.description: Index page: one full-page table without rules.

voyage-supplement.description: Voyage supplement: parallel columns of ship entries, not a table.

conventions: Rejoin words split by an end-of-line soft hyphen.
Keep original spelling, abbreviations and short forms.
Annotate phantom columns without transcribing them.
Rules are represented by the grid, never in the text.
Never transcribe leader dots: they are typographic filler between two fields.
Blank lines between groups of entries are not table rows: they are typographic spacing.
A cell with «——» is empty (ecel): do not transcribe the dash.
Indented continuation lines starting with «[» belong to the previous cell: join them with a space and drop the bracket.
A layout class never splits a typographic line: when the date shares the masthead line, it stays inside the Title.
